front.title: Cross-Device High Availability for BGP Sessions Using BFD

abstract.t: Some BGP deployments cannot rely on peers to negotiate Graceful Restart. An operator may instead want a standby routing instance on a separate device to continue an existing BGP connection and its associated Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) session after the active device fails, without changes at the peer. This document describes the deployment problem, the conditions under which takeover can be attempted, and how to verify continuity as observed by the peer. It does not specify a replication protocol, change BGP or BFD on the wire, or claim lossless forwarding. It provides operational criteria that can be applied independently of how the underlying TCP connection is preserved.
